title: Replace hard-coded zh-CN string in BudgetMeter with i18n key
description: The component `frontend/src/features/issues/components/BudgetMeter.tsx` contains a hard-coded Chinese string in a JSX text node (a Chinese character literal embedded directly in a `<span>`, `<div>`, or template). Replace the literal with a `useI18n().t("<namespace>.<key>")` lookup, add the corresponding entries to both the `zh-CN` and `en-US` dictionaries in `frontend/src/lib/i18n.ts`, and import `useI18n` from `@/providers/I18nProvider` if it is not already imported. Run `cd frontend && npm test` to confirm the i18n coverage test still passes (it enforces key parity between locales).
acceptance_criteria: No new hard-coded user-visible zh-CN string in the touched component
Replaced key registered in both zh-CN and en-US dictionaries
